source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned without a poll: the nomination list had three candidates for two seats (Eamon Reilly, Hugh Reilly and James Watterson), but the result report counts only four contests and says 'In only one case, of the four contests' (Fermanagh Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 7); the first meeting of the new council names Eamon O'Reilly and Hugh Reilly as members (Fermanagh Herald, 24 June 1967, p. 7). Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: First election of the new amalgamated Fermanagh County Council (county council, Enniskillen Borough Council and the Enniskillen, Irvinestown and Lisnaskea Rural Councils), polled Thursday 1 June 1967 (Fermanagh Herald, 3 June 1967, polling-day advertisement: 'POLLING DAY - THURSDAY, 1st JUNE, 1967'). Five divisions were nominated as contests (Crom, Doon, Irvinestown, Roslea and Enniskillen North) for twelve of the fifty seats; the other seventeen divisions were uncontested and the Herald of 20 May 1967 prints the full nomination list, so their members are recorded here. Crom did not go to a poll: the result report counts only four contests (Fermanagh Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 7: 'In only one case, of the four contests') and the first meeting names both Eamon O'Reilly and Hugh Reilly as members (Fermanagh Herald, 24 June 1967, p. 7), so the two Reillys were returned and James Watterson, the third nominee, did not take a seat. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. The two Reillys are recorded as returned; James Watterson, the third nominee, did not take a seat. The Herald's 10 June report does not print a Crom poll or figures. Returned unopposed.
